description: The tarot of /tarot (docs/FEATURES.md section 12.4, rulings R67 and R68), written by tools/decks-gen/gen.py from the owner's game library. spreads: each spread's positions in order, and its layout: where each lies, [x, y, turn] as gen.py says. meanings: each card upright and reversed. summary: the overall energy of a reading, by key, with the rule in gen.py (summary_cases are readings and the keys they give). Clients word everything from their own wording files.

summary.major_high: Many major arcana: big forces and turning points are at work.
summary.major_low: Mostly minor arcana: this is about everyday matters, not upheaval.
summary.major_balanced: A mix of major and minor arcana: the everyday ties into the larger path.
summary.reversed_many: Many reversed cards: obstacles, delays or inner doubts to deal with first.
summary.reversed_few: Nearly all upright: the way looks clear.
summary.suit_cups: Cups stand out: feelings, relationships and intuition.
summary.suit_pentacles: Pentacles stand out: money, work and practical things.
summary.suit_wands: Wands stand out: drive, creativity and action.
summary.suit_swords: Swords stand out: thought, decisions and conflict.
